_source: Consumable Gear sheet (owner scan 2026-11-03), 15 cards x2 copies

consumables.name: Crackling Stones
consumables.text:
1 [Charge] Place 1 Break [Break] or 1 Opening [Opening] token in the Knight Pool.
[Move action] or [Combat action] Gain 2 [Charge].
[JUDICIUM] [Discard] Discard 1 Armor [Armor] token from anywhere.
unclear: Two black action-box icons before 'or ... Gain 2': read as [Move action] (figure with speed lines) and [Combat action] (striking fist/figure); which is which is uncertain
Icon after 'Armor' is the breastplate/armor icon, written [Armor]

consumables.name: Flickering Torch
consumables.text:
1 [Charge] Wander.
2 [Charge] Choose a direction. Turn one Monster to face the chosen direction.
3 [Charge] Perform Rotation 1.

consumables.name: Fluorescent Pebbles
consumables.text: Spend X [Charge] to Trailmake 1+X. X must be 1 or more.

consumables.name: Pocket Sand
consumables.text:
Tumble. When you're knocked down or ignore Knockdown, spend X [Charge] from this card to place X Opening [Opening] tokens in the Knight Pool.
3 [Charge] Ignore a Rotation.
unclear: Trait reads 'Curse' (not 'Cursed' as on Devil's Hand Charm); small italic print

consumables.name: Alleviating Ointment
consumables.text:
1 [Charge] Gain +3 [Vigor] or discard 1 Poison token.
2 [Charge] Second Chance.

consumables.name: Basphille Herbal Brew
consumables.text:
[Combat action]+[Move action] 1 [Charge] Improved Rush.
When you spend the last [Charge] from this card, gain +1 [Passion].
unclear: Leading combined black action box with two icons joined by '+': read as [Combat action]+[Move action]; identity/order of the two icons uncertain

consumables.name: Red Fire-Wine
consumables.text:
During Adventure: After a Knight tests [Bravery], spend X [Charge] to add +X to the result.
During Clash: Spend all [Charge] from this card to Fire X, where X is the number of [Charge] spent.
unclear: Stat icon after 'tests' read as [Bravery] (matches the Bravery icon on Sign of the Saints)

consumables.name: Holy Pendant
consumables.text:
Your active Weapon gains the Holy Trait.
1 [Charge] Inspire 1.
Spend X [Charge] to Motivate X.

consumables.name: Preventive Leeches
consumables.text:
Start of Clash: Spend X [Charge] and place them on your Knight Board.
The next time you would gain Condition tokens, you may discard X [Charge] from your Knight Board to ignore X of them.
X [Charge] Lose -X [Vigor].

consumables.name: Lightfoot Map
consumables.text:
During Delve, you may move through Shortcuts.
1 [Charge] Trailmake 2. You may Wander during this Deep Fog Traversal (once).
3 [Charge] When you are about to resolve an Ambush, resolve an Encounter instead.

consumables.name: Heart's Sacrament Wine
consumables.text:
X [Charge] When you are about to test any Virtue (including Judgements), add +X to the result.
1 [Charge] When a Monster performs an AI, become its Target. When you lose [Vigor], gain that many [Charge].

consumables.name: Devil's Hand Charm
consumables.text:
X [Charge] Discard X Bane [Bane] tokens.
3 [Charge] Change a result of one [Attack die] you just rolled to a chosen result, then Bane 3.

consumables.name: Vicious Fang Necklace
consumables.text: 1 [Charge] Re-roll your Attack Roll (all dice). When you spend the last [Charge] from this card, perform a Bonus Attack!
